summary: This component displays a grid of blog article series as cards. It takes raw series data from a hook, enriches it with metadata like images and descriptions from a data file, and either shows the cards or a friendly 'no series found' message if the list is empty.

explanations.26: This sets a fallback image path that will be used if a series doesn't have its own image defined in the data file.
explanations.31: useMemo caches the enriched series list so it only recalculates when seriesList changes, avoiding unnecessary work on every render.
explanations.34: This finds the matching series data by looking for an entry in SERIES_DATA where the name matches the current series.
explanations.36: The nullish coalescing operator (??) means 'use the image from SERIES_DATA if it exists, otherwise fall back to the default image'.
explanations.45: This prioritizes the translated description from useSeriesList, but if that's missing (undefined), it falls back to the English description from SERIES_DATA.
explanations.53: If there are no series to display, render a centered 'no series found' message instead of an empty grid.
